description: Merge 2 to 20 PDF files into one document in the order given, optionally keeping their bookmarks. Cost in credits: ceil(total pages / 20), minimum 1. File input (files): base64 string, data: URI or {"url": "https://..."}. Output: a file (application/pdf) returned inline, at most 1 MiB. merged.pdf; meta: {page_count, files}

files.description: 2 to 20 PDFs in merge order; all together up to 10 MB.

items.description: A PDF: base64 string (or data: URI) or {"url": "https://..."}.

keep_bookmarks.description: Keep the bookmarks (outline) of the input files.

name: pdf_merge
title: PDF merger
